channel.title: Point blog
channel.description: Notes on building Point, and on showing AI agents exactly what you mean.

item.title: We talked to Point users and added an onboarding
item.description: Two things came out of our first user conversations. Point had no onboarding, and the default key was hard to press. Both are fixed in 0.1.3.

item.title: How to show Claude Code (or Cursor) a UI bug
item.description: Every way to get a screenshot of a bug into Claude Code or Cursor, which ones are fastest, and how to mark exactly which part you mean.

item.title: Talk to your coding agent instead of typing to it
item.description: Speaking is about three times faster than typing, and spoken prompts carry more context. What changes when you talk to Claude Code or Cursor, and where voice breaks.

item.title: The clipboard is the universal context layer for AI
item.description: Before any agent sees your problem, it passes through the clipboard. Why the one channel every app already shares is the natural context layer for AI, and what it costs.

item.title: Why it's so hard to explain things to your AI agent
item.description: Coding agents are good at the what and bad at the where. Why "fix the button on the left" goes wrong, and the habits that fix it.
